Payments that work in test mode but not with real customers
No legal notice, terms or privacy policy

about.title: About — Albert Grabar, full-stack web developer in Paris
about.description: Nine years in the French Foreign Legion, then a professional diploma in web and mobile development. I help launch AI-built apps and small business websites.
about.h1: Albert Grabar, full-stack web developer in Paris
paragraphs: I spent nine years in the French Foreign Legion, with the 2nd Foreign Engineer Regiment. It taught me to prepare a mission, deliver it on time and report in writing.

In 2025 I earned the French professional diploma in web and mobile development (EQF level 5) at AFPA Chartres. My final project, TECH NOIR, is an online store built with Symfony and React. Before the Legion I studied law, which helps when an app has to comply with GDPR.

Today I help founders of AI-built apps go from prototype to real product, and small businesses get a website that works. I work solo as a registered French micro-business, using AI tools under my control.
